answer: The grace period after a failed renewal payment is 7 days. The error SSO-409 means the user's email is already linked to another Tasklane workspace that has SSO enforced. The ACS URL for the Tasklane SAML app is https://auth.tasklane.example/saml/acs/<workspace-id>, where <workspace-id> must be replaced with the specific ID of the workspace.

If the client continues sending requests while limited for more than 5 minutes, it will be temporarily blocked for 15 minutes and receive the API_TEMP_BLOCKED error code instead. The API error WORKSPACE_SUSPENDED means the workspace has entered a suspended state because payment was not recovered by the end of the grace period, causing write endpoints to be blocked while read endpoints continue to function. To resolve this, the customer must successfully complete a payment, which will automatically lift the suspension within 10 minutes.
